197:   g_openvela_ready_expected = ready;
198:   g_openvela_ready_echo = UINT32_MAX;
199:   g_openvela_ready_result = -EINPROGRESS;
200:   g_openvela_ready_version = 0;
201:   g_openvela_ready_received = false;
202:   g_openvela_ready_waiting = true;
203:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);

206:                       PM_OPENVELA_READY_PROTO_V1);

208:     {
209:       ret = nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_openvela_ready_sem,
210:                                            MSEC2TICK(PM_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS));
211:     }
212: 
213:   if (ret > 0)
214:     {
215:       ret = -EIO;
216:     }
217: 
218:   flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
219:   g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
220:   received = g_openvela_ready_received;
221:   echo = g_openvela_ready_echo;
222:   result = g_openvela_ready_result;
223:   version = g_openvela_ready_version;
224:   rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);

227:                     version != PM_OPENVELA_READY_PROTO_V1))

290: static int pwc_rx(const void *raw)
291: {
292:   const uint8_t *bytes = raw;
293:   struct pwc_message message;
294:   unsigned int next;
295: 
296:   if (bytes == NULL)
297:     {
298:       return -EINVAL;
299:     }
300: 
301:   /* The logical mailbox invokes PWC callbacks while holding the driver lock.
302:    * Keep the queue update in that critical section instead of recursively
303:    * acquiring the non-recursive SMP spinlock here. */
304: 
305:   next = (g_head + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
306:   if (next == g_tail)
307:     {
308:       return -EAGAIN;
309:     }
310: 
311:   message.header = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[0];
312:   message.param1 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[1];
313:   message.param2 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[2];
314:   message.param3 = ((const uint32_t *)bytes)[3];
315:   g_queue[g_head] = message;
316:   g_head = next;
317:   nxsem_post(&g_pwc_sem);
318:   return OK;
319: }

321: static int pwc_worker(int argc, char **argv)
322: {
323:   int ret = OK;
324: 
325:   (void)argc;
326:   (void)argv;
327:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_ENTER);
328: 
329:   /* bk7258_mailbox_workers_start() pinned the bring-up thread to CPU0.
330:    * Kernel threads inherit that affinity before activation, so changing the
331:    * running PWC worker's affinity here is redundant and can trigger another
332:    * SMP scheduler transaction during the boot handshake. */

334:   g_worker_result = OK;
335:   g_worker_ready = true;
336:   bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_PWC_WORKER_READY);
337:   nxsem_post(&g_worker_sem);

339:   for (;;)
340:     {
341:       struct pwc_message message;
342:       irqstate_t flags;
343: 
344:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_pwc_sem);
345:       flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
346:       message = g_queue[g_tail];
347:       g_tail = (g_tail + 1u) % PM_QUEUE_DEPTH;
348:       rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
349:       /* A full software queue leaves the physical descriptor deferred with
350:        * no transport ACK.  Freeing one entry is the progress event that must
351:        * retry that descriptor even when no new mailbox IRQ arrives. */
352: 
353:       bk7258_mbox_kick_rx();
354:       /* Hardware power/clock actions stay in this thread, never in IRQ. */
355:       switch (message.header & 0xffu)
356:         {
357:           case PM_CTRL_PSRAM_POWER_CMD:
358:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
359:             if (g_psram_power_waiting &&
360:                 message.param1 == g_psram_power_expected_state)
361:               {
362:                 g_psram_power_state = message.param1;
363:                 g_psram_power_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
364:                 g_psram_power_version = message.param3;
365:                 g_psram_power_waiting = false;
366:                 nxsem_post(&g_psram_power_sem);
367:               }
368:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
369:             break;
370: 
371:           case PM_OPENVELA_READY_CMD:
372:             flags = rspin_lock_irqsave(&g_bk7258_driver_lock);
373:             if (g_openvela_ready_waiting &&
374:                 message.param1 == g_openvela_ready_expected)
375:               {
376:                 g_openvela_ready_echo = message.param1;
377:                 g_openvela_ready_result = (int32_t)message.param2;
378:                 g_openvela_ready_version = message.param3;
379:                 g_openvela_ready_received = true;
380:                 g_openvela_ready_waiting = false;
381:                 nxsem_post(&g_openvela_ready_sem);
382:               }
383:             rspin_unlock_irqrestore(&g_bk7258_driver_lock, flags);
384:             break;
385: 
386: #ifdef CONFIG_BK7258_PSRAM
387:           case PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD:
388:             if (message.param1 == 0u)
389:               {
390:                 ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
391:                                     PM_CP1_PSRAM_MALLOC_STATE_CMD,
392:                                     bk7258_psram_heap_used(), 0);
393:                 if (ret != OK)
394:                   {
395:                     printf("PWC: PSRAM malloc state response failed, "
396:                            "error=%d\n", ret);
397:                   }
398:               }
399:             else if (message.param1 == PM_POWER_MODULE_STATE_OFF)
400:               {
401:                 /* This CP notification is sent after physical power-down. */
402: 
403:                 bk7258_psram_power_lost();
404:               }
405:             break;
406: 
407:           case PM_CP1_DUMP_PSRAM_MALLOC_INFO_CMD:
408:             bk7258_psram_dump();
409:             break;
410: 
411:           case PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD:
412:             {
413: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
414:               ret = pwc_send_wait(PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD,
415:                                   PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT,
416:                                   (uint32_t)-ENOTSUP, 0);
417: #else
418:               int shutdown_ret = bk7258_psram_shutdown();
419: 
420:               ret = pwc_send_wait(
421:                       PM_CP1_RECOVERY_CMD, PM_POWER_PSRAM_MODULE_CPU1,
422:                       shutdown_ret == 0 ? PM_RECOVERY_STATE_FINISH :
423:                                           PM_RECOVERY_STATE_INIT, 0);
424: #endif
425:               if (ret != OK)
426:                 {
427:                   printf("PWC: recovery response failed, error=%d\n", ret);
428:                 }
429:             }
430:             break;
431: #endif
432: 
433:           default:
434:             break;
435:         }
436:     }
437:   return 0;
438: }

57: static int ipc_ack_result(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
58:                           int result)
59: {
60:   if (result == OK &&
61:       (ack == NULL || ack->reserved != IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE))

63:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
64:     }
65: 
66:   return result;

92: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
93: {
94:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
95:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
96:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
97:   int ret;
98: 
99:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
100:   if (ret < 0)
101:     {
102:       return ret;
103:     }
104: 
105:   *payload = parameter;
106:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
107: 
108:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
109:   message.header = command;
110:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
111:   message.payload_length =
112:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
113:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
114: 
115:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
116:                                   ipc_tx_complete,
117:                                   (void *)(uintptr_t)command);
118:   if (ret == OK)
119:     {
120:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
121:       if (ret == OK)
122:         {
123:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
124:         }
125:     }
126: 
127:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
128:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
129: }

132: {
133:   int ret;
134:

154: void bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll(void)
155: {
156:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
157:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
158:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
159:   clock_t now;
160:   int ret;
161: 
162:   if (!g_heartbeat_enabled || g_heartbeat_pending)
163:     {
164:       return;
165:     }
166: 
167:   if (g_heartbeat_completions != g_heartbeat_reported)
168:     {
169:       g_heartbeat_reported = g_heartbeat_completions;
170:       if (g_heartbeat_reported <= 3u)
171:         {
172:           printf("IPC: heartbeat ACK result=%d count=%lu\n",
173:                  g_heartbeat_result,
174:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_reported);
175:         }
176:     }
177: 
178:   if (g_heartbeat_result < 0)
179:     {
180:       g_heartbeat_failures++;
181:       if ((g_heartbeat_failures & (g_heartbeat_failures - 1u)) == 0)
182:         {
183:           syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat failed: %d count=%lu\n",
184:                  g_heartbeat_result,
185:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_failures);
186:         }
187: 
188:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
189:     }
190: 
191:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
192:   if ((sclock_t)(now - g_next_heartbeat) < 0)
193:     {
194:       return;
195:     }
196: 
197:   *payload = 0;
198:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
199:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
200:   message.header = IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION;
201:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
202:   message.payload_length = sizeof(*payload);
203:   g_heartbeat_result = -EINPROGRESS;
204:   g_heartbeat_pending = true;
205:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
206:                                  ipc_heartbeat_complete, NULL);
207:   if (ret == OK)
208:     {
209:       g_heartbeat_submissions++;
210:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
211:       if (g_heartbeat_submissions <= 3u)
212:         {
213:           printf("IPC: heartbeat queued count=%lu tick=%llu\n",
214:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_submissions,
215:                  (unsigned long long)now);
216:         }
217:     }
218:   else
219:     {
220:       g_heartbeat_pending = false;
221:       g_heartbeat_result = ret;
222:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY;
223:     }
224: }

255:       g_ipc_start_result = ret < 0 ? ret : OK;
256:     }
257: 
258:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
259:     {
260:       bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_HEARTBEAT_CREATE);
261:       pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY, 1536,
262:                            ipc_heartbeat_worker, NULL);
263:       bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_HEARTBEAT_CREATED);
264:       if (pid < 0)
265:         {
266:           g_ipc_start_result = pid;
267:         }
268:     }
269: 
270:   g_ipc_started = g_ipc_start_result == OK;
271: 
272:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
273:     {
274:       bk7258_boottrace_primary(BK7258_BOOT_HEARTBEAT_READY);
275:       printf("IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged by CP, heartbeat armed "
276:              "now=%llu deadline=%llu\n",
277:              (unsigned long long)clock_systime_ticks(),
278:              (unsigned long long)g_next_heartbeat);
279:     }
280: 
281:   return g_ipc_start_result;
282: }

32:   uintptr_t regaddr;
33:   uint32_t bit;
34:   int cpu = up_cpu_index();

36: #ifdef CONFIG_SMP
37:   if (cpu == 1 && extirq != BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX - BK7258_IRQ_FIRST)

40:     }

43:   if (extirq < 32)
44:     {
45:       regaddr = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN0 : BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN0;

48:   else
49:     {
50:       regaddr = cpu == 0 ? BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1 : BK7258_CPU2_IRQ_EN1;
51:       bit = 1u << (extirq - 32);
52:     }

54:   if (enable)

83:   putreg32(DEFPRIORITY32, NVIC_SYSH12_15_PRIORITY);

112:       return OK;
113:     }

123:         break;
124:       case BK7258_IRQ_USAGEFAULT:

126:         break;

128:         *bit = NVIC_SYSHCON_SECUREFAULTENA;
